title: QUORUM write with N = 3: acknowledge after 2 replicas, even with one down
caption: The third replica catches up later from a hint, read repair or anti-entropy repair.

messages.label: write c1 · ts = 105
messages.note: The client asks for consistency level QUORUM: W = 2 of N = 3.

messages.label: write ts=105
messages.note: The coordinator sends the write to all three replicas at once, not just two.

messages.label: write ts=105
messages.note: Replica 3 is down. The write still succeeds as long as 2 replicas answer.

messages.label: success
messages.note: The coordinator stores a hint for replica 3 and replays it when the node comes back.

scenarios.name: Hinted handoff
scenarios.summary: The coordinator keeps the missed write as a hint and replays it when replica 3 returns; hints expire (3 h by default), so longer outages need repair.

messages.label: write c1 · ts = 105
messages.note: QUORUM write while replica 3 is down.

messages.label: success
messages.note: W = 2 reached: the client is done.

messages.label: store hint for r3
messages.note: The hint is the missed mutation, saved on the coordinator's disk.

messages.label: replay hint ts=105
messages.note: Gossip reports replica 3 is back: the coordinator streams the hint and replica 3 is up to date again.

scenarios.name: Two replicas down
scenarios.summary: Only 1 of 3 replicas acknowledges, so the QUORUM write fails; the one replica that applied it keeps it, because failure doesn't mean rollback.

messages.label: write c1 · ts = 106
messages.note: Same QUORUM write, but now two replicas are unreachable.

messages.label: ack
messages.note: One ack, but W = 2 is needed.

messages.label: WriteTimeout (1 of 2)
messages.note: The client gets an error, yet replica 1 has the value and will spread it later. Retrying the same write (same timestamp) is safe; it's idempotent.

scenarios.name: Alternative: ONE
scenarios.summary: Consistency level ONE acks after the first replica: lowest latency and survives two replicas down, but the value is on one node until it spreads.

messages.label: write ts=107
messages.note: Still sent to all three replicas.

messages.label: success
messages.note: Fast, but if replica 1 dies right now before the others apply it, the write can be lost. Fine for metrics and logs, not for balances.
